podcast.body: This album, almost universally credited as the first official electronic music album in history, was released by White Noise. It stands as a monumental achievement, preceding the major works of later electronic music pioneers like Tangerine Dream and Kraftwerk. The album is considered a "holy grail" of electronic music, emphasizing its groundbreaking significance. "Y quiero un álbum en 1968 que se llama Electric Storm, uno de los santos grillales de la electrónica, el primer disco oficial que tenemos de música electrónica."

srcs.episode: Cómo una mujer inventó la música electrónica ⧸ Delia Derbyshire
